title: Anthropic is quietly becoming America's biggest corporate donor ahead of its mega IPO
summary: Anthropic employees donated $540 million in 2025 alone, nearly five times as much as the next-largest Fortune 500 donors, thanks to a company program that tops up every stock donation with extra shares and triples contributions from early employees. The article Anthropic is quietly becoming America's biggest corporate donor ahead of its mega IPO appeared first on The Decoder .
